rics.meaning: Production: Basic Metals — output from Indonesia's metals processing industry. Includes nickel processing (smelters), copper (Freeport), aluminum (Inalum).
rics.how_to_use: Surged post-2020 with Indonesia's nickel-export ban driving downstream smelter buildout (Morowali, Weda Bay). Tracks global stainless steel and EV battery demand. Major growth narrative for the next decade.

rics.meaning: Production: Chemicals and Chemical Products — chemicals-sector output. Includes petrochemicals, fertilizers, industrial chemicals.
rics.how_to_use: Cyclical with global oil prices (petrochemical feedstocks) and agricultural cycles (fertilizers). Pertamina, Pupuk Indonesia (state fertilizer holding) are major operators.
Tracks electrification investment and grid expansion. PLN's transmission/distribution buildout drives demand for transformers, switchgear, cables.

rics.meaning: Production: Machinery and Equipment NEC — capital-goods manufacturing. Tracks Indonesia's industrial-deepening cycle.
rics.how_to_use: Indonesia's machinery production share is small — most capital goods are imported. Surges signal local-content policy success.

rics.meaning: Production: Manufacture of Food Products — food-and-beverage manufacturing output. Indonesia's largest single manufacturing sub-sector.
rics.how_to_use: Stable, consumer-staple-driven. Tracks population growth and middle-class expansion. Major listed players: Indofood, Mayora, Wilmar.

rics.meaning: Manufacturing Production Index — BPS monthly manufacturing-only output. Subset of broader industrial production.
rics.how_to_use: Use for manufacturing-cycle tracking. Compare to S&P Global PMI manufacturing for cross-validation — when both move in same direction, signal is robust.

rics.meaning: Manufacturing Production, Quarterly — BPS quarterly manufacturing output. Aggregates monthly data.
rics.how_to_use: Use quarterly for GDP-component analysis (manufacturing GVA derives from this). Compare to manufacturing GVA (aIDVADGM/C) for cross-validation.

rics.meaning: Production: Motor Vehicles, Trailers, Semitrailers — Indonesia's auto manufacturing output. Indonesia hosts ~1.4M unit/year auto production capacity.
rics.how_to_use: Toyota, Daihatsu, Honda, Mitsubishi dominate (Japanese OEMs control ~95% of market). Auto exports to ASEAN, Middle East. Track for auto-sector cycle and ASEAN trade dynamics.

rics.meaning: Production: Rubber and Plastics Products — rubber + plastics-products manufacturing. Indonesia is a major natural rubber producer.
rics.how_to_use: Tracks consumer-goods (packaging, household plastics) and industrial (auto rubber components, hoses) demand. Watch alongside auto-industry cycle.

rics.meaning: Production: Textiles — textile-manufacturing output. Historically a major Indonesia export sector; now competing with Vietnam, Bangladesh.
rics.how_to_use: Sensitive to global apparel demand and IDR competitiveness. Indonesia textile sector has lost share to lower-wage Asia — sustained declines reflect this structural shift.

rics.description: Production, Wood & wood products except furniture
rics.meaning: Production: Wood and Wood Products (excl. Furniture) — wood-products manufacturing. Indonesia is a major plywood exporter; pulp & paper output also significant.
rics.how_to_use: Tracks global construction (plywood demand) and pulp-paper cycles. Concerns about deforestation and sustainable forestry (palm oil also implicated) drive ESG-policy attention.

rics.description: Industrial Production Index, % year on year, Standardized, Chg Y/Y
rics.meaning: Industrial Production Index, year-over-year change — pace of manufacturing output growth.
rics.how_to_use: Track trend; recent post-COVID recovery has shown 4-6% YoY. Sharp drops below zero signal manufacturing recession. Decompose by sector (food, chemicals, textiles, transport equipment) for source-of-weakness analysis.

rics.meaning: Industrial Production Index, standardized — manufacturing output index. Published monthly by BPS with ~6-week lag.
rics.how_to_use: Indonesia's industrial production tracking is less developed than DM peers — markets watch S&P Global Manufacturing PMI more closely. Use IPI for retrospective sector-mix analysis. Volatile due to small manufacturer sample.

rics.description: Industrial Production Index, Standardized, Chg P/P
rics.meaning: Industrial Production Index, MoM change — month-over-month industrial-output momentum.
rics.how_to_use: Volatile. Smooth with 3-month average for trend. Use YoY (aIDCINDYG/CA) for cyclical signal.
